description: B4 stale hits, the victims' half: four construction kbots (ARMCK: unarmed, so the towers stand) on hold 200 world units east of b4-guns' towers, owned by the peer that applies it. Applied again every few seconds it is the churn: each apply creates into the lowest free slots of the owner's block, which are the ones the towers' kills have just freed -- the slot recycling a factory under fire produces, without a build queue (queues are outside the scenario format).
